steps.content:
PLAN
1. List the directory and repository map to understand the file structure.
2. Read the `src/tlv.h` and `src/tlv.c` files to understand the TLV parser implementation.
3. Create a new file named `harness_fuzz.c` in the root of the repository.
4. Include the `src/tlv.h` header file in the `harness_fuzz.c` file.
5. Define the `int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)` function in the `harness_fuzz.c` file.
6. Declare a `TlvDoc doc` variable and call `tlv_parse(data, size, &doc)`. If `tlv_parse()` returns `TLV_OK`, call `tlv_free(&doc)` and `tlv_total_len_of_type(&doc, data[0])`.
7. Compile the harness using the command `clang -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined harness_fuzz.c src/tlv.c -I . -o /tmp/h`. If the compilation is successful, say "DONE". If it crashes, that is the win.
